meta.title: Etude Card Factory
meta.description: Turn a word, phrase or whole sentence into a set of language cards: scene-varied example sentences, one human-approved real photo per sentence, one TTS clip per sentence, packaged as a v2 lesson pack for the Etude trainer.

action.deleteConfirm: Delete this lesson pack? Approved review records are lost too.

label.author: Author
label.empty: No lesson packs yet. Type a word above to make the first one.
label.emptyNeedText: Type a word, phrase or sentence first.
label.noImage: No photo for this line yet
label.noAudio: No audio for this line yet
label.flatRejected: That image is flat or a gradient, not a photo — rejected
label.tooSmall: Too small (short edge must be at least {edge}px)
label.notImage: That is not an image file

hint.flow: Sentences first, then approve a photo and listen to the audio for every line. Nothing packs until every line is approved.
hint.reviewRequired: Unapproved photos and unheard audio never enter a pack.
hint.pixelOff: sharp is not available here, so images only get a structural check — flat images cannot be rejected.
hint.noCandidates: Nothing in this batch passed. Try another batch, or upload your own.

error.notInstalled: No Etude data directory found. Run Etude once, or set the data directory by hand.
